name: smwmusic-shadow-of-the-ninja-cybernetic-demonization-stage
title: Shadow of the Ninja - Cybernetic Demonization ~ Stage 5 (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Stage 5 from Natsume's Shadow Of the Ninja on the NES. Got the idea to do this after hearing the song in Magiopolis.

Very kick-ass theme from another one of Natsume's many banger games they made!! Perfectly captures the dark energy surrounding this burning industrial stage while still being incredibly intense.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. D Minor (Custom Pitch)
